question: GQ-007
subject: quality at 179 books — and two numbers of mine that overstated the problem
why: growth without a quality check is accumulation. I verified the NEW books read as English but had not re-measured the corpus defects I fixed at 78.

segmentation_held.investigated_rather_than_assumed: read the worst file: 31 KB total, 545 of 573 blocks are page numbers, "/Me.", and Internet Archive boilerplate. Low retention is CORRECT there — it is a pamphlet.
segmentation_held.honest_note: a 12-point gap — size is directionally right but does NOT explain a 17.9% outlier. Retention varies by document type.

two_numbers_of_mine_that_were_wrong.why_both_overstated: both used a LENGTH rule, which counts PREFACE (670 passages) and "Book  V." (536) as noise. Those are legitimate headings — a bare roman numeral carries no information, but "Book V." carries the book number.

fix.what: exclude bare roman numerals, stray month names, and sub-4-letter fragments — by SHAPE, not length
